name: orca
description: Orca lets you run a fleet of bots with your own subscription (e.g. Claude Code, Grok, Agy, Codex). Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

highlights: Bot Schedules & Triggers: run a bot every weekday at 9, or when a pull request opens, a check fails, or a webhook fires.
Mobile Emulator: run an iOS Simulator or Android emulator beside your agent, and let it tap, type, and check its own work.
Computer Use: when there's no CLI or API, agents can see and drive desktop apps and external browsers.
Automations: schedule prompts to run on any repo: nightly dependency bumps, weekly triage, flaky-test sweeps.

discovery.seed_reason: Run a fleet of parallel agents, each on your own subscription.
